title: Conformance vector
description: One line of a vectors/<source>/*.jsonl file, or of a corpus converted by tools/fetch_stare.py or tools/fetch_corpus.py. The bench sends kind, id, input and options as a request (request.schema.json) and scores the response against expected; a line without expected is run and saved but not scored.

id.description: Unique and stable: <source>/<kind>/<test>/<index> for test vectors, <corpus>/<opinion id> for eyecite's comparison sample, <corpus>/cap/<slug>/<folder>/<case> or <corpus>/cl/<cluster>/<hash> for the stare.pub sample.

source.description: Where the input came from: an engine's test suite (engine, version, file, test) or a corpus: stare.pub (corpus, source, and slug, volume, page and case, or ref; docs/protocol.md, Vector sources) or eyecite's comparison sample (corpus, opinion, column).

provenance.description: Where the expected answer came from. A vector without one takes its set's (the provenance in SOURCE.json); a set without one is unrecorded. See docs/protocol.md, Vector provenance.

status.description: verified: reviewed by the maintainer against the input. hand-checked: read by hand against the input when added, not yet verified. proposed: drafted and awaiting review. engine-output: copied from an engine's output. engine-tests: exported from an engine's own test suite.

engine.description: For engine-output and engine-tests: the engine and version.

drafted_from.description: What the expected answer was drafted from before it was checked, when that was an engine's output.

drafted.description: How and when the expected answer was drafted.

ground_truth.description: false: the vector is checked and scored as its status says, but is not ground truth for a dataset of citations found in opinion text (tier 0 of stare.pub's citation dataset), because its input wasn't taken from an opinion (source.fields). Absent: the status alone decides. See docs/protocol.md, Vector provenance.
